class.name: OcgXcafdocDimtoltool
class.brief_description: Attribute containing GD&T section of XCAF document. Provide tools for GD&T section management.
class.description: ! Attribute containing GD&T section of XCAF document. ! Provide tools for GD&T section management.

method.name: BaseLabel
method.description: Returns the label under which GD&T table is stored.

method.name: ShapeTool
method.description: Returns internal XCAFDoc_ShapeTool tool

method.name: IsDimension
method.description: Returns True if the label belongs to a GD&T table and is a Dimension definition.

method.name: GetDimensionLabels
method.description: Returns a sequence of Dimension labels currently stored in the GD&T table.

method.name: SetDimension_2
method.description: Sets a dimension to sequences target labels.

method.name: SetDimension_3
method.description: Sets a dimension to target labels.

method.name: SetDimension_1
method.description: Sets a dimension to the target label.

method.name: AddDimension
method.description: Adds a dimension definition to the GD&T table and returns its label.

method.name: IsGeomTolerance
method.description: Returns True if the label belongs to the GD&T table and is a dimension tolerance.

method.name: GetGeomToleranceLabels
method.description: Returns a sequence of Tolerance labels currently stored in the GD&T table.

method.name: SetGeomTolerance_1
method.description: Sets a geometry tolerance from theGeomTolL to theL label. Checks if theGeomTolL is a geometry tolerance definition first.

method.name: SetGeomTolerance_2
method.description: Sets a geometry tolerance from theGeomTolL to sequence of labels theL. Checks if theGeomTolL is a geometry tolerance definition first.

method.name: AddGeomTolerance
method.description: Adds a GeomTolerance definition to the GD&T table and returns its label.

method.name: IsDimTol
method.description: Returns True if theLab belongs to the GD&T table and is a dmension tolerance.

method.name: GetDimTolLabels
method.description: Returns a sequence of D&GTs currently stored in the GD&T table.

method.name: SetDimTol
method.description: Sets existing dimension tolerance to theL label.

method.name: IsDatum
method.description: Returns True if label belongs to the GD&T table and is a Datum definition.

method.name: GetDatumLabels
method.description: Returns a sequence of Datums currently stored in the GD&T table.

method.name: FindDatum
method.description: Finds a datum satisfying the specified name, description and identification and returns its label if found.

method.name: AddDatum_2
method.description: Adds a datum definition to the GD&T table and returns its label.

method.name: AddDatum_1
method.description: Adds a datum definition to the GD&T table and returns its label.

method.name: SetDatum_1
method.description: Sets a datum to the sequence of shape labels.

method.name: SetDatum_2
method.description: Sets a datum to theL label and binds it with theTolerL label. A datum with the specified name, description and identification is created if it isn't found in the GD&T table.

method.name: SetDatumToGeomTol
method.description: Sets a datum from theDatumL label to theToletL label.

method.name: GetDatum
method.description: Returns datum assigned to theDatumL label. Returns False if no such datum is assigned.

method.name: IsLocked
method.description: Returns true if the given GDT is marked as locked.

method.name: Lock
method.description: Mark the given GDT as locked.

method.name: Unlock
method.description: Unlock the given GDT.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: Set
method.description: Creates (if not exist) DimTolTool attribute.

method.name: GetID
method.description: Returns the standard GD&T tool GUID.
